_schema_notes: gate1_status: 'clean' | 'disqualified'. gate1_reasons (only when disqualified, one or more of): 'language_match' (resume reproduces posting/materials language), 'identity_mismatch' (submitted LinkedIn resolves to a different person, or is dead/fake), 'experience_mismatch' (LinkedIn is genuinely theirs but contradicts the resume's claimed position/employer), 'ai_artifact' (a literal leftover AI-drafting artifact in the resume text). experience_status (added 2026-09-04, only meaningful when gate1_status is 'clean'; 'not_applicable' if gate1_status is 'disqualified'): 'sufficient' | 'insufficient' -- total cumulative work experience across all listed roles, regardless of field, must be >= 3.0 years; internships count toward the total unless they are a strict majority (>50%) of it. experience_evidence states the computed total and its breakdown so the figure is checkable. gate2_status (only meaningful when gate1_status is 'clean' AND experience_status is 'sufficient'; 'not_applicable' otherwise): 'sustainability_experience' | 'no_sustainability_experience'. last_known_stage is the literal Lever pipeline stage label as of last_updated -- candidates whose stage moves away from 'New applicant' are removed from this file entirely per Max's standing instruction (2026-09-03): 'Keep all reviewed candidates in each report as you go UNLESS their status is no longer New Applicant.' Removals are logged in outputs/automation/resume-echo-review/run-log.jsonl, not kept here.
